description: SALEM — In a civil, policy-focused debate at Gardner Lake Firehouse Wednesday night, nearly 100 local residents and politicos from across the region watched and sometimes cheered loudly as State Rep. Nick Menapace and his challenger Anne Santoro took questions on electric rates, state budgets, Flock cameras and immigration.The debate was moderated by CT Examiner Editor-in-Chief Gregory Stroud.The biggest surprise of the debate may have been what wasn’t said or mentioned by either candidate – Pre
